title: Activity event
description: One thing a person did in their browser, as everything that reads the activity record sees it. read_events in seeress/activity.py makes an event from a line of the record, and Event.parse there reads one back. An event is a site, a path with no query and no fragment, a kind, a tab and a second. It carries no page title, no typed text, no query, no fragment and no full URL: what may reach a model is the site, the path, the hour and counts.

ts.description: The local time of the machine, to the second, as the logger writes it

site.description: A site: the host name, in lower case, without a leading 'www.' A browser accepts an underscore in a host name, as intranet servers often have one, and so does a site

path.description: The URL's path with its query and its fragment removed; '/' when the URL has no path

target.description: The tab, by the first eight characters of its identifier, or null when the logger cannot name it
